notes: - **New default file name: `SNAP-0001.png`.** The default prefix is now `SNAP-` instead of `snag_`, so a new install names its first capture `SNAP-0001.png`. A prefix you already have saved is not touched, and no existing file is renamed. If your settings never stored a prefix, new captures start at `SNAP-0001.png` in the same folder, next to your older files.
